{{Quote|Like construction machinery, the swamp slugs plow an inexorable path through the bog, devouring everything in their way.|[[Halka Four-Den/Legends|Halka Four-Den]] in her journals about Dagobah.|<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
'''Swamp slugs''' were giant amphibious gastropods native to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].

== Biology and appearance ==
An omnivorous species, swamp slugs had thousands of teeth and twenty-four pairs of legs. Their orange or golden eyes, the size of boulders, allowed them to see clearly beneath the murky, cloudy waters, while the two rubbery antennae on the top of their heads, which grew to two meters, utilized sonar to pinpoint exact locations of objects, searching by motion. 

Swamp slugs lived in shallow waters throughout the swamps of Dagobah, they  were omnivores, eating anything organic that they could fit in their mouths of jagged teeth. The teeth, or radula, lining the slug's esophagus would then pulverize into organic slime any plant or animal matter that it ingested. A hermaphroditic species, the swamp slugs [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduced]] sexually. Each partner would lay hundreds of eggs, most of which were eaten by other animals.<ref name="Wildlife" /> They exuded a thick, foul-smelling mucus which damaged the breathing organs of other species. They were not desirable to eat by other predators and were given a wide berth in the swamps.

Swamp slugs were very closely related to the [[Nos monster/Legends|nos monster]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] and the [[Kwazel Maw/Legends|kwazel maw]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

== History ==
[[File:SwampSlug-McQuarrie.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A swamp slug confronts a dragonsnake.]]
The [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] kept swamp slugs in the swamps and pools of her luxurious if notorious [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]], within her [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|palace]] near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], while [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends#Gardulla's revenge|in pursuit of escaped slaves]], one of Gardulla's [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Khiss (Dug)|Khiss]], spray-stick blasted a huge swamp slug back into the waters whence it surfaced to devour him.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>

Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a Republic research team led by [[Halka Four-Den/Legends|Halka Four-Den]] stationed on Dagobah witnessed a fight between a [[Dragonsnake/Legends|dragonsnake]] and a swamp slug. During the fight the swamp slug managed to overpower and kill the dragonsnake.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" />
